out.title: Anup Bagchi appointed MD & CEO of HDFC Bank
out.summary: RBI approved Anup Bagchi as MD & CEO for 3 years from October 27, 2026, succeeding Sashidhar Jagdishan whose tenure ends October 26, 2026; also appointed Additional Director from October 2, 2026.

person.name: Anup Bagchi
person.bio: ICICI Group veteran since 1992; former MD & CEO of ICICI Securities, Executive Director of ICICI Bank (2017-2023), currently MD & CEO of ICICI Prudential Life Insurance. IIM Bangalore and IIT Kanpur alumnus.
